projects.title: ETL Validation Framework
projects.description: A Python-based test harness that validates ETL outputs row-by-row against source systems, catching schema drift and load failures before they reach production.
projects.longDescription: Reusable data-quality framework that automates reconciliation between source and target tables, asserts schema contracts, and flags null/duplicate anomalies. Designed to plug into CI so broken pipelines fail fast.

projects.title: GreenPulse Energy Monitoring
projects.description: An energy-monitoring app that ingests meter readings, tracks consumption trends, and surfaces usage anomalies through a clean TypeScript dashboard.
projects.longDescription: Full-stack monitoring tool pairing a Python ingestion/analytics backend with a TypeScript frontend to visualize real-time and historical energy usage, flag spikes, and report on efficiency.

projects.title: YouTube Trending ETL on AWS
projects.description: A cloud-native pipeline that lands YouTube trending data into S3, transforms it with Glue, and exposes it for analytics in Athena — all provisioned via Terraform.
projects.longDescription: End-to-end AWS data pipeline: ingestion to S3, cataloging and transformation with Glue, and SQL analytics over Athena. Infrastructure is fully codified in Terraform (HCL) for reproducible deploys.

projects.title: Structured Data Extraction from PDFs
projects.description: A document-parsing pipeline that pulls tables and key fields out of unstructured PDFs into clean, query-ready datasets, packaged in Docker for portable runs.
projects.longDescription: Extraction workflow that turns messy PDF documents into structured records — parsing tables and fields, normalizing output, and shipping as a containerized, reproducible job. Prototyped in Jupyter.

projects.title: dbt + Airflow Pipeline on GCP
projects.description: An orchestrated analytics pipeline that schedules dbt transformations with Airflow on GCP, turning raw warehouse tables into tested, documented models.
projects.longDescription: Modern ELT stack: Airflow orchestrates scheduled dbt runs on BigQuery, applying tested and documented transformations with dependency-aware DAGs. Containerized with Docker for consistent environments.
